methodSections.heading: Salad & Dressing
steps: Rinse the saltfish, if using, and cook in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Peel and de-seed the papaya and then shred using a mandoline.
Finely dice the peppers, chop up the green onion and mix both with the shredded papaya, saltfish and coriander.
Add the vinegar, mango pulp, black pepper and chopped-up coriander to a bowl. Slowly add the oil while whisking until the dressing is emulsified.
Add half of the dressing to papaya salad and season to taste.

methodSections.heading: Prawns
steps: Marinate the prawns in the jerk marinade for at least a few hours.
Grill the prawns over a high heat for around 30 seconds per side then arrange on top of the salad and serve.

methodSections.heading: Coconut Jumby
steps: Cut a 4-5cm length from a stem of lemongrass and thoroughly muddle in an empty cocktail shaker. Add 2 mint leaves and roughly 1 tsp of lime zest and muddle some more.
Measure in the rum, coconut water and agave syrup, top with ice and shake well.
Double strain into a tall glass full of fresh ice.
Garnish with a few mint leaves, a pinch of lime zest and coconut.
